Keep all furniture, foliage, basket and decorative details on the LEFT; the entire right half must remain calm, light and nearly empty, and the upper edge should also be quiet so it blends into a cream navigation bar. Colors: warm ivory close to #FFF8EF, sage green foliage, honey rattan, touches of soft terracotta/coral and a restrained hint of blue sea. Soft natural light, gentle analogue grain, editorial travel photography, human and welcoming, no oversaturation, no glossy CGI, no artificial plastic textures.
